routine.instructions: Looking at what the agent has just done and what it will do next, how many of the next steps are routine: mechanical work such as reading files, searching, renaming, formatting or repeating a known change, that needs no judgment about the design or the goal?
levels: none of the next steps are routine: the next step needs judgment
one or two routine steps, then judgment is needed again
several routine steps in a row
a long run of routine steps before any judgment is needed
